source: Sorftime MCP tool declarations exposed to this session; official documentation URL https://open.sorftime.com/mcp

tools.name: ali1688_category_tree
tools.description: Query the product category structure on the 1688 platform.

node_id.description: Optional: if specified, returns the child categories of this node_id; if not specified, returns the top-level and second-level categories. Data type: string.

tools.name: ali1688_product_request
tools.description: Query the product details on the 1688 platform.

product_id.description: The product ID to be queried.

tools.name: ali1688_product_search
tools.description: Search product information on the 1688 platform across multiple dimensions.

cumulative_sale_count_max.description: Filter products with cumulative sales volume less than or equal to this value.

cumulative_sale_count_min.description: Filter products with cumulative sales volume greater than or equal to this value.

dropshipping_price_range_max.description: Filter products with selling price less than or equal to this value.

dropshipping_price_range_min.description: Filter products with selling price greater than or equal to this value.

node_id.description: Query based on a category (not limited to leaf categories); if specified, search within that category.

online_date_range_max.description: Filter products by listing end date, date format yyyy-MM-dd.

online_date_range_min.description: Filter products by listing start date, date format yyyy-MM-dd.

page.description: Which page of data to query, defaults to page 1.

recent_30_day_sale_max.description: Filter products with sales quantity in the last 30 days less than or equal to this value.

recent_30_day_sale_min.description: Filter products with sales quantity in the last 30 days greater than or equal to this value.

repurchase_rate_max.description: Filter products with repurchase rate less than or equal to this value.

repurchase_rate_min.description: Filter products with repurchase rate greater than or equal to this value.

rights.description: Filter by rights/benefits. Multiple choice, comma-separated, e.g. "1,2,3". 1: 7-day free return, 2: free shipping insurance, 3: ship within 48 hours.

service_score_max.description: Filter products with overall service score less than or equal to this value.

service_score_min.description: Filter products with overall service score greater than or equal to this value.

sku_count_max.description: Filter products with SKU count less than or equal to this value.

sku_count_min.description: Filter products with SKU count greater than or equal to this value.

stock_count_max.description: Filter products with stock count less than or equal to this value.

stock_count_min.description: Filter products with stock count greater than or equal to this value.

supplier_member_type.description: Filter by supplier member type, single choice. 1: Deep certified, 2: Non-deep certified.

supplier_type.description: Filter by supplier type, single choice. 1: Powerful merchant, 2: Super factory.

tools.name: ali1688_product_search_from_image
tools.description: Search products on the 1688 platform by image.

image_url.description: Image URL, required. Must pass a web image URL, and the image size must not exceed 1MB.

page.description: Which page of data to query, defaults to page 1.

tools.name: ali1688_product_variations
tools.description: Find the variation (SKU) data of a product on the 1688 platform by product ID.

product_id.description: The product ID to be queried.

tools.name: ali1688_similar_product
tools.description: Find sourcing/wholesale suppliers for a product on the 1688 platform. Can be used to analyze the procurement cost price of a product.

page.description: The page index of the query result. Defaults to page 1. Each page returns 20 records.

search_name.description: The product name to search for.

tools.name: shopee_category_request
tools.description: Query Best Seller products under a Shopee category. Optional queryDate for historical review (only sub-categories supported).

node_id.description: The category ID to look up.

page.description: The page index of the query result. Defaults to page 1. Each page returns 20 records.

query_date.description: Optional, format yyyy-MM-dd. If specified, used to query historical data for the natural week containing the date (only sub-categories support historical review; for non-sub-categories this parameter is invalid).

tools.name: shopee_category_search_from_name
tools.description: Search related category markets on Shopee by name. Used to obtain category node IDs and category names.

name.description: The category name to search for.

tools.name: shopee_category_tree
tools.description: Query the product category structure on the Shopee platform.

node_id.description: Optional: if specified, returns the child categories of this node_id; if not specified, returns the top-level and second-level categories. Data type: string.

tools.name: shopee_category_trend
tools.description: Used to query the historical trend of a Shopee category market. Each call returns one trend dimension; select the trendIndex enum accordingly.

node_id.description: The category node ID to query.

trend_index.description: The historical trend type to query.

tools.name: shopee_change_favorite_keyword
tools.description: Move a favorited keyword on the Shopee platform to a specified dict (auto-created if it does not exist).

from_dict.description: Optional. If specified, only move the keyword from this source dict.

tools.name: shopee_del_favorite_keyword
tools.description: Delete a specified keyword from my Shopee keyword favorites.

dict.description: Optional. If specified, delete the keyword from this dict only.

tools.name: shopee_favorite_keyword
tools.description: Add a keyword to my Shopee keyword favorites. If the specified dict does not exist, it is created automatically.

dict.description: Optional. If specified, add the keyword to this favorites dict (auto-created if not exists).

tools.name: shopee_get_favorite_keyword
tools.description: Query the favorited keywords in my Shopee keyword favorites. Specify `dict=all` to query every keyword across all dicts.

dict.description: Optional. If specified, queries keywords under the given folder; pass `all` to query all keywords.

page.description: The page index of the query result. Defaults to page 1. Each page returns 100 records.

tools.name: shopee_get_favorite_keyword_dict
tools.description: Query the list of dicts (folders) in my Shopee keyword favorites.

page.description: The page index of the query result. Defaults to page 1. Each page returns 100 records.

tools.name: shopee_keyword_relation_results
tools.description: Search Shopee related products by keyword, returning up to 20 products per page.

keyword.description: The keyword to query (e.g. summer dress).

page.description: The page index of the query result. Defaults to page 1. Each page returns 20 records.

tools.name: shopee_keyword_search
tools.description: The list of trending keywords on Shopee, sorted by monthly search volume by default.

keyword.description: Optional. The keyword to query (e.g. summer dress). When provided, the search is keyword-specific; otherwise it returns the trending list.

page.description: Optional. Page index, defaults to page 1. Each page returns 20 records.

rank_max.description: Optional. Filter by maximum monthly rank.

rank_min.description: Optional. Filter by minimum monthly rank.

search_volume_max.description: Optional. Filter by maximum monthly search volume.

search_volume_min.description: Optional. Filter by minimum monthly search volume.

tools.name: shopee_product_request
tools.description: Query detailed information of a Shopee product.

tools.name: shopee_product_search
tools.description: Search product data on the Shopee platform with multi-dimensional filters, sorted by monthly sales volume descending.

comment_count_range_max.description: Optional. If specified: limit maximum comment count.

comment_count_range_min.description: Optional. If specified: limit minimum comment count.

month_sale_volume_range_max.description: Optional. If specified: limit maximum monthly sales volume (val <= setting value).

month_sale_volume_range_min.description: Optional. If specified: limit minimum monthly sales volume (val >= setting value).

node_id.description: Optional. If specified: query within a category (not limited to sub-categories).

online_date_range_max.description: Optional. If specified: limit listing end date (yyyy-MM-dd).

online_date_range_min.description: Optional. If specified: limit listing start date (yyyy-MM-dd).

page.description: Page query, max 20 products per page. Defaults to 1 (pages start from 1, not 0).

price_range_max.description: Optional. If specified: limit maximum selling price (val <= setting value).

price_range_min.description: Optional. If specified: limit minimum selling price (val >= setting value).

shop_location.description: Optional. Shop location type: 1 = local store, 2 = cross-border store.

shop_type.description: Optional. Shop type: 1 = ordinary store, 2 = preferred store, 3 = flagship store.

star_range_max.description: Optional. If specified: limit maximum star rating.

star_range_min.description: Optional. If specified: limit minimum star rating.

variation_count_range_max.description: Optional. If specified: limit maximum variation count.

variation_count_range_min.description: Optional. If specified: limit minimum variation count.

tools.name: shopee_product_search_from_name
tools.description: Search related products on Shopee by name, returning up to 20 products each call.

name.description: The product name keyword to search for.

tools.name: shopee_product_trend
tools.description: Supports historical trends across five dimensions: star rating, comment count, price, cumulative sales, and last-30-day sales.

query_end.description: Optional. Query end time (yyyy-MM-dd). Defaults to the current time.

query_start.description: Optional. Query start time (yyyy-MM-dd). Default last 1 year. When span > 1 year, each call consumes 10 credits.

tools.name: shopee_shop_request
tools.description: Query Shopee seller (shop) details. Returns basic information and a Top500 snapshot of the shop's products.
